alt: A sun-filled living room viewed from the doorway, with a brass plant stand by the south-facing window catching warm light; shown in six different material schemes—walls, flooring, shelving, cushions—each altering the room's entire atmosphere.
text:
the room never moved. the plant corner either. but when light hits that corner the whole place pivots. same brass stand by the south window. same waiting-to-bloom patience. what changes is everything: walls, floors, what you'd actually linger in.
